title.value: From analytic to synthetic-organizational pluralisms: A pluralistic enactive psychiatry
title.justification: The title is clearly stated in the front section of the document.
title.quote: From analytic to synthetic-organizational pluralisms: A pluralistic enactive psychiatry

extractions.description: This paper discusses the inadequacies of reductionist approaches in psychiatry and explores a variety of pluralistic frameworks, focusing on the enactive approach. It contrasts non-integrative and integrative pluralism, proposing enactivism as a synthetic-integrative framework within psychiatry.
